title: Credit Department Schedule of Invoice Terms and Arrears Charges, Energy Division
content:
Every invoice raised on an account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts runs on the terms the catalogue writes for that programme. The schedule below carries, for each programme, the payment terms in calendar days from the invoice date, the grace period in calendar days after the due date, the late charge, the monthly service charge on overdue balances, and the days past due at which further deliveries are held.

| Programme | Payment terms, calendar days | Grace period, calendar days | Late charge, USD | Monthly service charge, percent | Deliveries held at, calendar days past due |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Will-Call Propane Account | 15 | 10 | 15.00 | 1.5 | 30 |
| Keep-Full Automatic Delivery Account | 15 | 10 | 15.00 | 1.5 | 45 |
| Budget Payment Plan Account | 15 | 10 | 15.00 | 1.5 | 45 |
| Contract Gallon Pre-Buy Account | 15 | 10 | 15.00 | 1.5 | 45 |
| Bulk Farm Fuel Delivery Account | 20 | 10 | 25.00 | 1.25 | 45 |
| Cardtrol Fleet Fueling Account | 20 | 10 | 25.00 | 1.25 | 30 |

## Notes to the schedule

1. Terms stand at 15 calendar days on the four propane programmes and at 20 calendar days on the Bulk Farm Fuel Delivery and Cardtrol Fleet Fueling Accounts.
2. The grace period is 10 calendar days on every programme in the catalogue without exception.
3. The late charge stands at 15.00 USD on the four propane programmes and 25.00 USD on the two refined fuels programmes; the monthly service charge stands at 1.5 percent and 1.25 percent respectively.
4. The delivery hold figure is 45 calendar days past due on four programmes and 30 calendar days on the Will-Call Propane Account and the Cardtrol Fleet Fueling Account, the two programmes on which the cooperative carries the least standing balance for the member.
